**Sources cited across this entry:**

- https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/page/journal/15567583/homepage/productinformation.html (fetch blocked, HTTP 402 paywall)

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review.type detail**: Confirmed via multiple sources this is a journalist-written newsletter with no peer review, but the authoritative Wiley product-information page could not be fetched (HTTP 402) to quote a formal statement verbatim — inference drawn from consistent third-party descriptions (Wiley marketing copy, ESI listing) rather than one canonical policy doc.
- **ai_policy.leniency_1_5 / gate**: No journal-specific AI policy exists because there is no author manuscript submission process; only generic publisher-wide Wiley AI guidance was found, which cannot be confidently mapped onto a title that doesn't take external research submissions.
- **preprint.allowed**: No preprint policy found or applicable — newsletter content is not preprinted research.
- **positioning.accepts_now / methods_welcome / framing_required**: No recent (2024-2026) 'accepted article' listing of author-submitted research was found because the outlet publishes staff-written news items, not submitted research papers; the Wiley product-information page (most likely to describe scope precisely) returned HTTP 402 Payment Required and could not be fetched.
- **experiential.review_time_months / desk_reject_pct / acceptance_note / reviewer_culture**: SciRev has no listing for this title, and no first-hand accounts appear on 小木虫, 知乎, fabiaoji, or r/AskAcademia — consistent with it not being a title researchers submit manuscripts to for peer review.
